If you'd like, I can also help with your inbox, such as drafting a reply to Sarah about the logo options or to Mike about the partnership call.

I should be upfront: I don't have a memory feature that carries over between conversations, so I can't guarantee I'll remember this later. If you'd like to keep track of it, you could jot
down the title in your notes app. I'm happy to help with your inbox anytime, too.
